sn54.6:1.2: Tatra kho Bhagavā || la || etad avoca || ||
sn54.6:1.3: Bhāvetha no tumhe bhikkhave ānāpānasatin ti || || 3.
sn54.6:1.4: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Ariṭṭho Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn54.6:1.5: Ahaṃ kho bhante bhāvemi ānāpānasatin ti || ||
sn54.6:1.6: Yathā katham pana tvam Ariṭṭha bhāvesi ānāpānasatinti || || 4.
sn54.6:1.7: Atītesu me bhante kāmesu kāmacchando pahīno || anāgatesu me kāmesu kāmacchando vigato || ajjhattam bahiddhā ca me dhammesu paṭighasaññā suppaṭivinītā ||
sn54.6:1.9: Evam khvāham bhante bhāvemi ānāpānasatin ti || || 5.
sn54.6:2.1: Atthesā Ariṭṭha ānāpānasati nesā natthī ti vadāmi ||
sn54.6:2.2: api ca Ariṭṭha yathā ānāpānasati vitthārena paripuṇṇā hoti ||
sn54.6:2.3: taṃ suṇāhi sādhukam manasi karohi || bhāsissāmi || ||
sn54.6:2.4: Evam bhante ti kho āyasmā- opaccassosi || || 6.
sn54.6:3.1: Kathañca Ariṭṭha ānāpānasati vitthārena paripuṇṇā hoti || || 7--13.
sn54.6:3.2: Idha Ariṭṭha bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkamo oDīgham
sn54.6:3.5: paṭinissaggānupassī Assasissamī ti sikkhati || paṭinissaggānupassī Passasissāmīti sikkhati || || 14.
sn54.6:3.6: Evaṃ kho Ariṭṭha ānāpānasati vitthārena paripuṇṇā hotī ti || || 1--2.
